species.name: Cragchough

evolves.flag_text: once you have passed a Cornish lesson

dex.text: Red beak, black coat and a mouthful of coastal opinions. Tumbles above the cliffs for the pure joy of it.
dex.fact: Red-billed choughs died out in Cornwall by 1973 but held on along the Welsh coast, and Wales is now their main UK stronghold.

species.real: The chough is on Cornwall's coat of arms, and in 2001 wild choughs came back to the Lizard on their own, nesting in Cornwall again the next year for the first time in decades.

dex.text: Red of beak and leg, black as a tin-miner's hat, and carrying the weight of a legend that says King Arthur never died, he just changed into one of these.
dex.fact: The chough, long a symbol of Cornwall, died out there in the 1970s and returned by itself in 2001.
